title: Re-Roll Hand 1 — Choose the visual world for Road Damage AI
question: Fresh hand dealt (Assigned: BRO / NHAI Kilometer-Stone & Chevron System). Keep it, pick an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: BRO / NHAI Kilometer-Stone & Hazard Chevron
options.lineage: Indian National Highway (NHAI) & Border Roads Organisation (BRO) cast-concrete kilometer stones and retro-reflective hazard chevrons
options.thesis: Engineered for 80 km/h roadside legibility: bold highway-yellow crown headers, lime-washed concrete cards, stencil numerals, and crimson hazard blocks.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px milestone frame: a semicircular/crowned highway-yellow header ('NH-48 · KM 14+250 · GPS LOCK') above a high-contrast Live Camera Patrol HUD with a bottom severity pulse strip, single reversed 'LOG DEFECT' plate, and 1px SVG callout lines linking each bounding box to its severity card.
options.risk: Highway-yellow crown and hazard chevrons must be used with strict restraint so they highlight critical alerts without overwhelming dense tables.

raised.raise: A hairline severity pulse strip along the bottom of the Live Camera HUD plots the continuous 0–100 severity score across recent patrol frames.
A 1-device-pixel SVG connector rule links each detected bounding box directly to its severity breakdown card.
Exactly one element per screen—the primary 'LOG DEFECT' trigger or top-ranked urgent segment—reverses onto an opaque full-strength plate.

options.label: ATMS Highway Command & Linear Strip-Map
options.lineage: Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) highway corridor consoles and linear chainage strip maps
options.thesis: An asphalt-slate highway operations console that pairs a live patrol HUD with a linear 50m corridor strip-map and tabular priority breakdown.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px dark-asphalt command shell: top live corridor strip showing 50m segments along the road, center Live Camera Patrol HUD with crisp bounding boxes and FPS/GPS telemetry, and bottom one-thumb shutter + Auto-Patrol bar.
options.risk: The most natural dark-mode operations center for highway monitoring; familiar to traffic and fleet management tools.

options.label: Segmented Defect Pass & Live Reranking Gate Board
options.lineage: Segmented travel boarding passes paired with live-reranking departure gate boards
options.thesis: Every road capture issues a stamped, segmented Defect Pass while the 50m Priority Board smoothly reranks rows in place and holds an alert glow on changed segments.
materials: live-reranking priority rows with persistent change highlight
options.viewport: Portrait 360px split: upper perforated Inspection Pass (Live Camera HUD + tabular GPS/Extent stub) above a live-reranking 50m Segment Board where newly logged potholes animate their segment row upward and hold an orange alert badge.
options.case: Maps directly to Road Damage AI's core loop: capturing a defect immediately reranks the 50m segment board in place.
options.risk: Must keep pass perforation motifs functional rather than decorative.

options.label: Concourse Split-Flap Dispatch Board
options.lineage: Rail concourse mechanical split-flap boards in matte black and brushed steel with amber/red row lamps
options.thesis: The 50m maintenance queue as a mechanical dispatch board: fixed character cells, amber/crimson row lamps, and per-character flap cascades when priorities update.
materials: amber and crimson row indicator lamps
options.viewport: Portrait 360px brushed-steel frame: Live Camera HUD window docked above a matte-black split-flap priority board where segment IDs, road classes (NH/SH), and Priority Scores (P=74.2) clack into place.
options.case: Makes priority score recomputation and status changes ('OPEN -> SCHEDULED') visceral and unmistakably legible.
options.risk: Split-flap cell grid works best on ranked tables and telemetry headers; body prose must stay clean sans.

options.label: Typographic Panorama & Live Flip Tiles
options.lineage: Pure-black typographic tile grids where chrome disappears and giant numerals + flat color fields are the interface
options.thesis: Delete all card borders and bevels: giant severity numerals and flat crimson/amber/cyan live tiles tilt under the thumb and flip to reveal 4-term math.
options.viewport: Portrait 360px zero-chrome grid: full-width Live Camera tile above square live-flipping tiles for Severity (78.4), Priority (74.2), GPS lock, and one-tap Shutter flood.
options.case: Exceptional one-handed mobile thumb ergonomics and zero visual clutter on 360px screens.
options.risk: Oversized cropped headers require careful tuning so long technical labels never clip.

options.label: Pulsar Waveform & Color-Code Index
options.lineage: Factory Records catalog sleeves with stacked white pulse lines and color-coded block legends
options.thesis: A matte-black surface dominated by a stacked white severity waveform and coded color blocks.
options.viewport: Stacked white severity waveform lines over vast black space with a small catalog index.
options.case: Violates our accessibility rule that severity must always show text label + icon + color, never cryptic color blocks decoded on hover.
options.kept: A live hairline severity pulse strip at the bottom of the camera HUD plotting recent frame scores.
options.risk: Cryptic color codes slow down field triage.

options.label: Twin-Column Centre-Rail Apparatus
options.lineage: Wide-margin scholarly reference editions with twinned columns around a 1px vermilion key rail
options.thesis: Two narrow text columns twinned around a 1px vermilion centre rail inside four-inch annotation margins.
options.viewport: Twinned narrow columns flanking a centre key rail with wide outer margins.
options.case: Twinned columns plus wide annotation margins cannot fit a 360px mobile camera viewfinder and map.
options.kept: 1-device-pixel SVG connector rules linking detected bounding boxes directly to their severity cards.

options.label: 11° Raked Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: Pocket airline timetables on a lit goldenrod bed with 11-degree sheared parallelogram containers and a single font size
options.thesis: Every container rakes 11 degrees over a lit goldenrod bed with all text locked to a single pixel size.
options.viewport: Raked 11-degree parallelogram panes sliding laterally across a goldenrod light table.
options.case: 11-degree sheared containers distort orthogonal YOLO bounding boxes and map viewports.
options.kept: Reserving a single full-strength opaque reversed plate per screen for the primary action.
options.risk: Sheared geometry fights rectangular camera frames.

canonCard.label: Clean Civic GIS & AI Triage App
canonCard.thesis: The modern municipal GIS and computer-vision standard: crisp slate cards, semantic red/amber/emerald severity pills, and a clean bottom-tab mobile shell.
canonCard.viewport: Standard mobile-first civic inspection app with a clean top status bar, rounded camera viewfinder card, confidence slider, and 4-icon bottom navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar and frictionless, though visually similar to standard modern GIS/GovTech apps.
